summary: Anghami Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of board member Michael Johnson, effective August 10, 2026, with no disagreement stated. The board appointed Guergui Stoyanov as Audit Committee member and chairman to fill the vacancy. This is a routine board-level change without disclosed opposition or strategic significance; it is not a forced CEO/CFO departure. The filing is a standard notification of director transition and committee assignment, with no deal terms, premiums, or transactional elements. Watch for any subsequent disclosure if the resignation relates to broader governance shifts.
